'''Rod Latham Mains And Toys (Sept. 1998)''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/dst4.htm Mains And Toys], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319183619/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/dst4.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Rod Latham]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Event:''' [[1998 Loughborough Regional Qualifier]]
* '''Played:''' Sept. 1998

== Introduction ==
Trandosite lists this as one of [[Rod Latham]]'s tournament decks: played 6th September 1998, 3 wins and 0 losses from 3 games (differential +58).<ref name="trandosite" />
